items.source: Note: Do not use this for a "multipart/form-data" request since RFC 7578, Section 4.2 and also RFC 5987 mention it does not apply to multipart requests.
items.translation: 注意： 请勿将此用于 "multipart/form-data" 请求，因为RFC 7578 第 4.2 节以及 RFC 5987 均指出其不适用于 multipart 请求。

items.source: Set the value of the filename parameter. The given filename will be formatted as quoted-string, as defined in RFC 2616, section 2.2, and any quote characters within the filename value will be escaped with a backslash, for example, "foo\"bar.txt" becomes "foo\\\"bar.txt".
items.translation: 设置 `filename` 参数的值。给定的文件名将按照 RFC 2616 第 2.2 节中定义的 quoted-string 格式进行格式化，且文件名值中的任何引号字符都将用反斜杠转义，例如，"foo\"bar.txt" 将变为 "foo\\\"bar.txt"。

items.source: Set the value of the name parameter.
items.translation: 设置 name 参数的值。

items.source: Sebastien Deleuze, Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sergey Tsypanov
items.translation: Sebastien Deleuze, Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sergey Tsypanov

items.source: Set the value of the filename that will be encoded as defined in RFC 5987.
items.translation: 设置将按 RFC 5987 定义进行编码的 `filename` 的值。
